offer.pitch: XVcache gives organisations dated evidence that a document existed, unchanged, at a given time. With the planned XVcache Coffre horodaté subscription, timestamps will be qualified electronic timestamps issued by Certigna, a qualified trust service provider: under Art. 41(2) of the eIDAS Regulation their date and the integrity of the data are presumed, and they are recognised as qualified in all Member States (Art. 24a(6)). XVcache itself is not a qualified trust service provider. The document content stays on your computer; the hosted server receives the SHA-256 fingerprint and an optional label, and processes your IP address. Each result is a V/X verdict and a one-page PDF report in 24 EU languages. Limits: not a bailiff report, not a signature, not legal advice; the evidential weight is for the court.

offer.present_title: XVcache — dated evidence for your documents
offer.present_body: XVcache gives dated evidence that a document existed unchanged at a date. In the planned Coffre horodaté subscription, Certigna will issue qualified timestamps: eIDAS art. 41(2) presumes their date and the integrity of the data; they are recognised as qualified in all Member States (art. 24a(6)). XVcache is not a qualified provider. A shared daily token bears its issue time, not the time of submission; until then, or if Certigna is unavailable, the proof stays pending, with no fallback to FreeTSA. Document content stays on your computer; the server receives the fingerprint, an optional label, and the IP address. A V/X verdict and a one-page PDF report are issued.
